newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips slump, NYSE sets trading curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips slump, NYSE sets trading curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks declined on Monday, giving back ground after Friday's record closing highs and the triple-witching expiration of index futures and options.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average slid around 57 points or 0.74 percent to 7739, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index arbitrage trading.
The Nasdaq composite was up 0.67 at 1448 after a brief foray into negative territory.
Shares of Philip Morris Cos Inc sagged after Friday's announcement of a landmark industry settlement.
